traces
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| extend
    clientRunId = tostring(customDimensions["clientRunId"]),
    flowName = tostring(customDimensions["flowName"])
| project timestamp, message, severityLevel, clientRunId, flowName, customDimensions
| order by timestamp desc

tabs.title: httpPosts_weather

tabs.content:
let traceEvents = traces
    | where timestamp > ago(24h)
    | where message startswith "weather-flow."
    | extend clientRunId = tostring(customDimensions["clientRunId"]),
             flowName    = tostring(customDimensions["flowName"])
    | where isnotempty(clientRunId);
let started = traceEvents
    | where message == "weather-flow.started"
    | project clientRunId, flowName, startTime = timestamp, session_Id, user_Id;
let finished = traceEvents
    | where message in ("weather-flow.succeeded", "weather-flow.failed")
    | project clientRunId, endTime = timestamp, outcome = message, severityLevel;
started
| join kind=leftouter finished on clientRunId
| extend durationMs = datetime_diff("millisecond", endTime, startTime)
| project clientRunId, flowName, startTime, endTime, durationMs, outcome, severityLevel, session_Id, user_Id
| order by startTime desc
tabs.title: customTraceDuration

tabs.content:
let startedView = 
traces
| extend clientRunId = tostring(customDimensions["clientRunId"]), appName = tostring(customDimensions["ms-appName"]), appid = tostring(customDimensions["ms-appId"])
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| where message has "started"
| where message has "weather-flow"
| project timestamp, message, severityLevel, clientRunId, startTime = timestamp, appName, appid;
let endedView = 
traces
| extend clientRunId = tostring(customDimensions["clientRunId"]), appName = tostring(customDimensions["ms-appName"]), appid = tostring(customDimensions["ms-appId"])
| where timestamp > ago(24h)
| where message has "ended"
| where message has "weather-flow"
| project timestamp, message, severityLevel, clientRunId, endTime = timestamp, appName, appid;
startedView
| join kind=leftouter endedView on clientRunId
| extend durationMs = datetime_diff("millisecond", endTime, startTime)
| project clientRunId, durationMs, severityLevel, startTime, endTime, appid, appName
